arch: F5-TTS v1 Base (flow-matching DiT, ~336M), zero-shot cloning

init_candidates.why: already trained on ~1,417h of 11 Indic languages incl. Hindi/Marathi (Devanagari), so Devanagari char embeddings exist; Nepali not included
permissive fallback; English-only alpha checkpoint, card says 'still inferior to official F5'

text_input_ab.chars: raw normalized Devanagari (metadata_chars.csv) - the IndicF5 approach, reuses its Devanagari embeddings
text_input_ab.phonemes: frontend G2P, one symbol per phoneme via encode_for_f5 (metadata_phonemes.csv) - fixes schwa deletion but needs new embeddings
text_input_ab.decide_by: held-out CER + speaker similarity at ~20k updates

train: ai4bharat/Rasa Nepali (55.1h, 2 studio voices, CC-BY-4.0, synthesis consent)
optional_extra: ai4bharat/IndicVoices Nepali (~507h field audio; filter by SNR/CER first)
data.accent_note: IndicVoices(-R) Nepali was recorded in Darjeeling/Kalimpong/Assam (Indian Nepali); balance with Nepal-recorded audio. SLR54 (Kathmandu, 165h) is CC-BY-SA - include only if releasing weights CC-BY-SA
data.eval: google/fleurs ne_np + 50 held-out speakers from mine_reference_voice.py
data.language_mix: Nepali only (adding English during fine-tune hurt IndicF5: MUSHRA 66.2 vs 73.4)

vocab: extend vocab.txt + text embedding before finetune (finetune_gradio 'Check Vocab'/'Extend', or expand_model_embeddings); init new rows from existing tokens

train.cmd: accelerate launch --mixed_precision bf16 src/f5_tts/train/finetune_cli.py --exp_name F5TTS_v1_Base --finetune --pretrain <init.pt> --tokenizer custom --tokenizer_path vocab.txt
train.select_checkpoint: by held-out CER (MMS/Kriti) + ECAPA speaker similarity, not the last step

compute.pilot: 1x H100, ~20k updates, to pick init + text input
compute.full: ~8x H100 for 100-150k updates, ~2-4 days, ~$2-4K (estimate scaled from IndicF5's 32x H100 run)
